fluff.overview: Federated Suns infantry benefit from one of the strongest industrial bases in the Inner Sphere, with AFFS quartermasters able to supply platoons with standardized equipment and ammunition from a logistics network that few rival states can match. Motorized platoons ride light vehicles that give them the speed to screen advancing columns, patrol supply routes, and respond to threats faster than foot infantry, though they sacrifice protection for that mobility. These Xenoplanetary Condition Troops are trained and equipped for combat in hostile environments where standard infantry cannot operate effectively, carrying specialized survival gear alongside laser weapons that allow them to fight in extreme temperatures, toxic atmospheres, or unusual gravity conditions.
